name: Doradora
source:
A Cosmic Wraith, and a descendant of a super powerful fighting race. Unlike all of her kin, she does not have a dragon-like head or tough scales.

She is incapable of doing anything on her own. She is very friendly. She has trouble expressing her emotions well, she devised the hand puppets "My two-headed sisters" to help her communicate. She is hopelessly bad as ventriloquism.

She is capable of breathing fire but doesn't know how to go about it. If she could do it, she may very well be stronger than Satan.

She is one of the few cosmic wraiths that can feed on human semen for purposes other than procreation. Her lower body temperature makes her comfortable to mate with as she takes bod heat away from the male.

Her body gradually turns hotter and hotter the longer she has sex, she will gradually lose control of herself indulging in the heat created by her mate. Her soft body and heat makes her mate fall more deeply in love with her.
